# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 51 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Tablets Found by Solomon; Closing Colophon

---

**1** In the days of Solomon king of Israel, the tablets of Seth were discovered. Solomon read them and gave thanks to God.

**2** Solomon had all the words copied down and placed in the royal chronicles of Israel.

**3** This is the end of the life of Adam and Eve — the first of all the living — whose hope was and is in the mercy of God.

**4** Glory to God, who has mercy on all his creatures, now and forever.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
